verdict.rationale: Ente Auth documents end-to-end encrypted cloud backups and cross-device sync, so a user who signs in on a new device should get their tokens back. It also documents a recovery key for when you are locked out, plus password-encrypted local backups. However, the pack contains no explicit step-by-step walkthrough for restoring tokens on a replacement device after losing the phone, and offline mode stores codes on only one device. Missing for 10: a documented new-device restore/login procedure, an explicit lost-phone recovery flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a successful restore.

support.subject: As an everyday user, losing my phone doesn't lose my accounts — a documented recovery path restores my tokens on a new device

citations.quote: Auth provides end-to-end encrypted cloud backups so you don't have to worry about losing your tokens.
Your codes sync across all your devices, end-to-end encrypted.
This key can be used to bypass Ente 2FA in case you are locked out.
Automatic daily backups: When enabled, Ente Auth creates one local backup per day when you open the app.
